According to the discussion that took place on April 25, 2026, Li Hua mentions bringing "our best vibes" to the band's jam session. While the specific instruments or contributions from other band members are not explicitly detailed in the provided text, Li Hua's mention suggests that Li Hua is emphasizing the importance of a positive and energetic atmosphere that each member, including himself, is expected to contribute to the session. The text does not list particular instruments or additional musicians that Li Hua is bringing; instead, it focuses on the collective mood and enthusiasm that Li Hua wants to ensure will be part of their musical gathering.

The relevant portion of the discussion highlighting this sentiment can be found in the following exchange:

Li Hua: "Can't wait! Sunday will be here before we know it! 🎉 Let's make some awesome music! 🎶😊
Li Hua: Yuriko, if you have any favorite styles or genres, feel free to throw them into the mix! It'll be fun experimenting together! 🎶😊
Li Hua: Absolutely! I'm super excited about it! Let’s create some unforgettable moments this Sunday! 🎉🎸
Li Hua: For sure! It’s going to be an epic evening! Let’s make sure to bring some snacks and drinks to keep the energy going! 🍕🥤
Li Hua: Fantastic! I’ll bring some drinks to keep us refreshed! It's going to be such a fun night! Can't wait! 🎶🍹✨
WolfgangSchulz: Good call, Li Hua! Snacks and drinks are a must! Keeps the vibe high and the creativity flowing! What are your favorites? 🍕🥤😊
YurikoYamamoto: I love finger foods and some fruit! Maybe we could also have some chips and dips on the side? That would be perfect for jamming! 🎶🥳

In summary, Li Hua is contributing by planning to bring snacks, specifically drinks, to complement the group's vibe and energy during their musical session. The text does not detail additional musical instruments or artists beyond this general statement of creating an enjoyable atmosphere.
